request: Run system-optimization on this proposal: finance wants to cut our shared CI runner pool from 10 runners to 8, because the pool averages 78 percent utilization, 'so a fifth of it sits idle'. Measured over the last 30 days: a job runs 12 minutes on average; a job waits 9 minutes in the queue on average, and 31 minutes between 14:00 and 17:00, when most merges land; the number of jobs per day is steady, and nothing else about the workload is changing. Should we cut the pool?

expect.criterion: system-optimization #1: a proposal to change a shared delivery resource loads the optimization method
system-optimization #2: a cut that drives a shared resource past sustainable utilization is not adopted
system-optimization #3: the flow signal cites a measured quantity when measurements are supplied
system-optimization #4: the record names the measured constraint or says it was not measured
system-optimization #5: the record states the risk left after the decision
summary-led-report #2: the decision opens with the four blocks in order
